_instructions: run defaults to exclusive mode for VID_4132&PID_2107. Use --no-exclusive to observe without suppressing keys; learn is always observation only. Never write the keyboard or access its unknown FF00 vendor interface.
bindings uses the measured factory shortcuts: E, B, Ctrl+Z, Space, G, Ctrl+F, H, L, ], [. Other keyboard keys are suppressed without an action and logged as unbound.
Keys accept vk:0xXX, scan:0xXXXX:flags, ctrl+vk:0x5A, or alt+vk:0x4C. Combine ctrl/shift/alt/win in any order; modifiers are tracked per deck device. Scan flags are E0/E1: 0, 2, 4, 6.
Exact modifier combinations take priority over bare vk, then scan. A modifier alone triggers only an explicit bare binding. Only the first key-down triggers; release and auto-repeat do not.
Actions: slot 1-8, next_wait, approve, deny, cycle +1/-1, auto. Copy learn output to customize bindings.

The optional _f13_f22_bindings object preserves the previous map, including wheel/volume examples. To use it, replace bindings with that object; it is not loaded automatically and does not reprogram the keyboard.
